info.name: Flashyre - Candidate API (data-driven)
info.description: One request, one row per scenario from api/data/candidate-api.json (generated from e2e/data/candidate.json by tools/data-to-newman.mjs).

exec: // ---- shared helpers (copied into each request that needs them) ----
id: pm.iterationData.get('id'), title: pm.iterationData.get('title'), role: pm.iterationData.get('role'),
status: pm.iterationData.get('status'), form: pm.iterationData.get('form'), json: pm.iterationData.get('json'),
const emails = { recruiter1: 'email_recruiter1', recruiter2: 'email_recruiter2', admin: 'email_admin', super: 'email_super' };
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.environment.get(emails[role]), password: pm.environment.get('qa_password') }) } },
(err, res) => { const t = res && res.json().access; if (t) pm.collectionVariables.set('token_' + role, t); then(t); });
const opts = { url: BASE + String(row.path || '').replace('{{runId}}', pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')), method: row.method || 'GET', header: {} };
if (row.form) opts.body = { mode: 'formdata', formdata: Object.entries(row.form).map(([key, value]) => ({ key, value: String(value).replace('{{runId}}', pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')) })) };
if (row.json) { opts.header['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'; opts.body = { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(row.json) }; }
